$comment: Versioned evidence asset for RC-061 (CAPA-013, REQ-SAFE-037 (d), HAZ-007).
The measured false-candidate rate of the device's longitudinal new/enlarging rule, with its source record.
every longitudinal comparison, rendered by the view (LongitudinalResultPanel.tsx) in the reader's language
and by the report notice (ai_report.py). No component holds these numbers.
applies_to_rule must equal the rule in force (current_rule_parameters()); otherwise the rate is withheld
and the view says that no measured rate is available. Change the figures only with a new source record,

measurement.intervals: patients: exact Clopper-Pearson 95 %; per patient: patient-cluster bootstrap 95 %

secondary_measurement.dataset: MSLesSeg first pairs (public), approximate truth (independently drawn masks, resampled to MNI)

source.study: Paper C pilot, pre-registered (protocol commit 6233b4b; arm A4 inputs logged before analysis, efb203f); arm A4 is a pre-registered secondary arm

limits: No stable patients were studied: the rate of a false statement in a patient without real change is not measured.
All 20 open_ms patients had many expert-marked changes (446 expert lesions >= 3 mm); 2D 3-mm FLAIR.
Measured on FLAMeS masks; in production the comparison runs on whatever segmentations exist (manual, imported, other tools).
The device's own rigid registration was not exercised (the providers' co-registration was used).
